```yaml
name: CI & Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  ci:
    name: CI (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
          - os: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          override: true

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache cargo git
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      - name: Cache target
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-${{ matrix.target }}-

      - name: Check
        run: cargo check --target ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Format
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Test
        run: cargo test --target ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}

  release:
    name: Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: ci
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache cargo git
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      - name: Build for all targets
        run: |
          targets=(
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            x86_64-apple-darwin
            aarch64-apple-darwin
            x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          )
          for target in "${targets[@]}"; do
            cargo build --release --target "$target"
          done

      - name: Prepare artifacts
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep '^version' Cargo.toml | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d ' "')
          BIN_NAME=$(cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps | grep -m1 name | cut -d\" -f4)
          mkdir -p dist
          for target in x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu x86_64-apple-darwin aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-pc-windows-msvc; do
            if [[ "$target" == *"windows"* ]]; then
              EXT=".exe"
              ARCHIVE="zip"
            else
              EXT=""
              ARCHIVE="tar.gz"
            fi
            cp target/"$target"/release/"$BIN_NAME"$EXT" dist/
            cd dist
            if [[ "$ARCHIVE" == "zip" ]]; then
              zip -r "../${BIN_NAME}-${VERSION}-${target}.zip" *
            else
              tar czf "../${BIN_NAME}-${VERSION}-${target}.tar.gz" *
            fi
            cd ..
            rm -rf dist/*
          done

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-artifacts
          path: |
            *.zip
            *.tar.gz

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-artifacts
          path: artifacts

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          files: |
            artifacts/*.zip
            artifacts/*.tar.gz
```
